title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Goodwill Waivers of Documentation Fees
content:
The documentation desk may relieve a customer of a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` fee as a gesture of goodwill. This page defines which fee entries can be waived, the desk's authority per entry, the customer's yearly allowance and the time within which the waiver must be asked for.

## Checklist for a goodwill waiver

A goodwill waiver of one fee entry is granted at the documentation party's request only if every item holds:

1. **Waivable kind of fee.** Any documentation fee entry qualifies except the fees for a release against a letter of indemnity and for a replacement set after lost originals; those two are never waived.
2. **Within authority.** The amount of the fee entry is no higher than the desk's waiver authority for the document's type. An entry exactly equal to the authority qualifies.
3. **Within the yearly allowance.** The goodwill waivers the customer has received on documentation, across all of its documents, during the 365 calendar days ending on the day of the waiver (that day included), number fewer than the type's allowance.
4. **Within the request period.** The waiver is asked for no later than the last day of the type's request period. To find that last day, start from the date the fee entry was booked and move forward by the type's request period in calendar dates; a request made on the day so reached is still inside the period.
5. **Not already waived.** No fee entry is waived more than once.

## Effect

A waiver always cancels the entire fee entry it refers to and is recorded for the full amount of that entry; part-waivers do not exist.

## Line's keying error

A correction fee that was charged for an error the line itself made in keying the document is not dealt with as an ordinary goodwill waiver. It is reversed by a goodwill waiver entry that stands outside the customer's allowance, and only where the draft kept on file establishes the error; what the customer says, taken alone, never establishes it.

## Values by document type

| Document type | Waiver authority (USD per fee entry) | Goodwill waivers allowed in 365 days | Request period (calendar days after the fee was booked) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | 50.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | 50.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 75.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | 75.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | 100.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | 0.00 | 0 | 15 |

With an authority of 0.00 and an allowance of 0, no goodwill waiver can be granted on an `AHL Switch Bill of Lading`.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| `AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading`, fee entry of 75.00 | Within authority |
| Same type, fee entry of 95.00 | Above authority; not waived |
| `AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading`, customer has 1 documentation waiver in the trailing 365 days | Allowance available (1 is fewer than 2) |
| Same type, customer has 2 in that period | Allowance used up |
| `AHL Straight Bill of Lading` fee booked 1 March, request on 31 March | Inside the period (last day) |
| Same fee, request on 1 April | Outside the period |
